title: Graph UI Obsidian-Benchmark Refresh Implementation Plan
summary: Task-by-task implementation plan making the Sigma graph view Obsidian-like: theme-token colors, zoom-linked label fade, whisper edges, community color groups replacing hulls.
notes: Path is docs/superpowers/plans/ (no adr|prd|spec path signal) and there is no frontmatter. Content is implementation contracts: a GraphTheme interface, fixed 12-slot palettes with an explicit 'do not reorder' constraint, labelAlpha fade thresholds, Sigma settings keys, and GraphSettings field removal (showHulls) - SPEC signals dominate over DOC prose. Classified SPEC rather than DOC because it carries binding technical constraints; the authoritative design doc it implements is linked in cross_refs. No decision/consequences sections (not ADR), no user stories or acceptance criteria (not PRD). Confidence medium: it is an execution plan derived from a separate spec, so some constraints may be restatements.
